decisions.reason: Turnaround management is central to the firm's data-driven, integrated airport operations strategy and is prominently presented with its own page.
Apron connectivity enables the integrated platform, though after the 2024 pruning of apron monitoring it could be folded into broader suite offerings.
Billing software sits further from the operational core but provides recurring software revenue, so the firm keeps it while monitoring its fit.
Apron resource management complements turnaround and planning software and strengthens the end-to-end suite the firm is building.
